metadata.title: Probate  Part 7, "Example of a Probate File" by James Tanner
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription: This is Part 7 of James Tanner's Probate Series.  This presentation will give you a good idea of the types of documents that might be found in a probate record.
